title: A Modular, Responsive, and Accessible HPC Dashboard Built upon Open OnDemand
problem: HPC systems have high barriers to entry for non-expert users due to reliance on command-line tools; growing user community requires more accessible interfaces.
motivation: As HPC adoption expands beyond specialists, web-based interfaces reduce barriers and improve researcher accessibility.
method: Modern web-based dashboard built on Open OnDemand framework with redesigned functional pages: announcements, system status, job information, resource usage.
key_novelty: Modular, responsive redesign of HPC dashboard interfaces integrated with Open OnDemand; emphasis on modern design and accessibility.
contributions: Responsive design for diverse client devices
Streamlined access to announcements and system status
limitations: Abstract-only; lacks user studies, adoption metrics, or quantitative usability improvements
